title: Muraja'ah: Al-Haqqah after the break: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 26 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 26. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ (١) مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ (٢) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ (٣) كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ (٤) فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ (٥) وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ (٦) سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ (٧) فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ (٨) وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ (٩) فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً (١٠) إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ (١١) لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ (١٢)

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 69:13 to 24.
Listening rota: today's group recites one section of Al-Haqqah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link their weakest section, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target each.

questions.q: Extend: write the four section themes from memory.
questions.a: Peoples who denied; the Day and the right-hand record; the left-hand record; the truth of the Qur'an.

questions.q: Which section tells of the record given in the right hand?
questions.a: A) 69:13 to 24. 69:19: 'So as for he who is given his record in his right hand ...'

questions.q: Think again: Al-Haqqah has 52 ayat. How would you split it into sections to revise it?
questions.a: By themes: the peoples destroyed, the Day, the two records, the Qur'an's truth.
